description.zh: WAF规则组ID。您可以通过[DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the WAF rule group. You can call [DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~) to query the ID.

description.zh:
语言类型，将以此语言返回。取值范围：

- **en**：英文。
- **zh**：中文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **en**: English.

- **zh**: Chinese.
The page number. The default value is **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **20**.

description.zh:
查询条件，JSON序列化后的字符串。格式如下：

`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"防护策略ID范围","RuleIds":"防护规则ID范围","RuleNameLike":"防护规则名称","DomainNames":"防护域名","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

>不传默认查询所有防护规则。
description.en:
The query conditions, as a JSON-serialized string. The format is as follows:

`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"<IDs of mitigation policies>","RuleIds":"<IDs of rules>","RuleNameLike":"<Rule name>","DomainNames":"<Protected domain names>","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

> If you do not specify this parameter, all rules are returned.

description.zh:
待查询规则组的范围。
- **in**：规则内，返回该规则组内的规则。
- **out**：规则外，返回在规则全集中并且不在该规则组中的规则。
description.en:
The scope of the rule group to query.

- **in**: returns the rules in the rule group.

- **out**: returns the rules that are in the complete rule set but not in the specified rule group.

title.zh: 查询自定义WAF规则组详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-group --biz-language zh --id 1012 --scope in --query-args RiskLevel_:_,_ProtectionType_:_,_ApplicationType_:_,_RuleIdLike_: --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnWafGroup --region cn-hangzhou --QueryArgs 'RiskLevel_:_,_ProtectionType_:_,_ApplicationType_:_,_RuleIdLike_:' --Language zh --Scope in --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Id 1012
